en:
Enables the use of the basic user interface.

Lv.1 Allows to trade with other players.
Lv.2 Allows to chat with other players via public and whisper chat.
Lv.3 Allows to use trade posts.
Lv.4 Allows sitting to double HP & Mana recovery.
Lv.5 Allows to join and create parties, and unlocks every other skill tree.
A passive ward that shields the master from harm.

The Master and his Bestia can start to cook meals on fire places. These meals apply
certain buff effects when they are eaten.

Level 1 enables you to cook at a camp fire
`-20%/lv` cooking time
`+20%/lv` success chance
Restores a small amount of health to the target.

Sets a patch of ground alight. Everything standing in the flames is burnt every 1.2s for
9.6s - eight times in all.

Aimed at the ground rather than at a creature, and it does not care whose side anyone is on:
the flames burn the caster too.

Hurls a bolt of searing fire at a single enemy.

Must be channelled - moving or taking damage interrupts the cast.

Blesses the target with divine power.

Temporary increase of STR, DEX, INT and HIT. Versus Undead property and Demon race
Bestia halves their DEX and INT instead.

Feigns death to avoid menace of nearby enemies. This skill can be switched on and off.

Apply bandages to a Bestia and channel a healing effect over 10s. The cooldown of this
skill is 3 minutes. A Bestia can only receive a single First Aid every 60 secs.

Whichever is greater, a share of the maximum health of the target or a flat amount:
Lv.1 `+30%` max HP or `+100 HP`
Lv.2 `+60%` max HP or `+200 HP`
Lv.3 `+100%` max HP or `+350 HP`

Allows you to construct useful items of daily use and structures which can be placed in
the world.

Level 1 enables you to place a Workbench
`+5%/lv` success chance
`+10 item lv/lv` of items that can be produced, up to item level 100+ at max rank

You are very skilled in working with tools and raw material. Building structures in the
world is very quick for you and the Bestia under your command.

`-10%/lv` construction time of structures
`+2%/lv` construction success chance

You are able to rework items to put slots in them in which runes can be slotted.
Requires an Engraving Set which will be consumed in the process.

`+10%/lv` success chance
`-2%/lv` chance to destroy the item when the engraving fails, from 30% down to 12%
1 rune slot, rising to 2 at Lv.4 and 3 at Lv.7

Enables the smith to refine the finest ores into ingots. A must have to produce the raw
materials for weapon or armor forging. Burns Coal as fuel.

Level 1 enables you to place a Furnace
`+30%/lv` refinement success chance

Able to forge weaponry from raw ingredients. Higher skill level unlocks forging
higher-level weapons.

Level 1 enables you to place a Forge

The counterpart to Forge Weapon: forges plate, mail and shields from smelted ingots.
Higher skill level unlocks forging higher-level armor.

Level 1 enables you to place a Forge

You can repair damaged or broken equipment to refurbish and make it usable again.
Higher levels unlock repairing equipment of a higher item level.

`+20 item lv/lv` of equipment that can be repaired, up to item level 100+ at max rank

Deeper knowledge of weapons and armor that raises the odds of successfully refining
either one further after forging. If an upgrade fails the equipment can be destroyed.

`+4%/lv` success chance when upgrading a weapon or armor
`+1%/lv` success chance when forging

The capstone of the forge. Makes a Blacksmith's hands steady enough to trust with the
rarest ore.

`+5%/lv` Weapon/Armor forging chance
`+5%/lv` upgrade chance

Build and operate Mana Harvesters which channel mana from the environment into raw
crystals - the source of magic for many use cases.

Level 1 enables you to place a Mana Harvester
`-5%/lv` harvesting time
`+3%/lv` crystal yield

Refine the raw and unstable mana crystals harvested by a Mana Harvester into the finest
arcane raw materials used to build powerful magic artifacts.

`-4%/lv` chance a crystal shatters during refinement
Higher levels unlock refining higher-grade crystals

Create runes from Bestia essences. These runes are imbued with the power of the Bestia
and can be slotted into a weapon or piece of equipment that has been prepared with Item
Customization. An attempt to convert a Bestia into an essence destroys the Bestia.

`+5%/lv` chance of success

Can create magic artefacts by binding sustained enchantments to an item, going well
beyond what a single etched rune can hold.

`+4%/lv` enchantment chance
`-7%/lv` chance to destroy the item if the binding fails

Teaches which roots, herbs and mana-touched growth are worth the harvest, and how to
keep them potent until they reach the cauldron.

Lv.1 Can collect herbs up to level 20
Lv.2 Can collect herbs up to level 40
Lv.3 Can collect herbs up to level 60
Lv.4 Can collect herbs up to level 80
Lv.5 Can collect herbs up to level 100+

The core craft of the Alchemist: brewing reagents down into potions, tonics and other
consumables. Builds directly on what Herbalism teaches about picking the right ingredient.

Lv.1 Can craft basic potions and elixirs up to level 10 at a workbench cauldron.
Lv.2 Can craft potions and elixirs up to level 20.
Lv.3 Can craft potions and elixirs up to level 30.
Lv.4 Can craft potions and elixirs up to level 40.
Lv.5 Can craft potions and elixirs up to level 50. Failed brews return half of the raw
reagents used instead of losing them entirely.
Lv.6 Can craft potions and elixirs up to level 60.
Lv.7 Can craft potions and elixirs up to level 70.
Lv.8 Can craft potions and elixirs up to level 80.
Lv.9 Can craft potions and elixirs up to level 90.
Lv.10 Can craft potions and elixirs up to level 100+, unlocking the highest-level potion
and elixir blueprints.

The Alchemist's capstone. Where Alchemy brews what nature already provides,
Transmutation reshapes mundane matter itself into the rare magically-infused resources
needed for strong artifact creation and weapon refinements.

Higher levels unlock transmuting higher-grade infused resources
Increased yield and success chance for Alchemy.

Your Bestia and Master gain an increased HP and Mana regeneration rate.

`+3% effect/lv`

Your Bestia and Master gain an increased tolerance against high and low environment
temperatures.

`+3%` higher tolerance/lv

You and your Bestia know every kind of terrain.

`+3%` higher movement speed/lv

With this skill you are able to catch fish. Fish can be cooked and are used for food and
trading.

`+20 fish lv/lv` that can be caught, up to fish level 100+ at max rank

The player is able to gather wood resources faster.

`-3%/lv` wood gathering time
`+2%/lv` resource drop chance

Sets snares and deadfalls that keep working for the master even while they're off doing
something else, passively catching small game over time for meat and pelts on a later
check-in.

`+4%/lv` chance a snare yields a catch
Higher levels unlock snares for larger game

Bestia under your control gain faster experience and require less food to maintain their
stamina out in the open.

`+5%/lv` EXP gain
`-2%/lv` stamina loss

Detailed knowledge of the Bestia and their behavior makes it easier for you to tame and
catch them.

`+5%/lv` chance to tame

Raises the carrying capacity of your own Master.

`+10%/lv` weight limit

Raises the carrying capacity of every Bestia under your control.

`+10%/lv` weight limit

Enables the player to chart unexplored land, revealing terrain that can be shared,
traded on, or built on.

Spends one sheet of blank vellum and produces a chart of the ground around the surveyed
point. Each level reaches a kilometre further, up to five at full rank.

Hardens the master and their Bestia against travel through hostile terrain, far from the
comfort of a settlement. Reduces the stamina and HP drain caused by hostile terrain and
environmental hazards.

`-10%/lv` stamina drain in hostile terrain
`-10%/lv` environmental hazard damage

An instinct for reading the sky and wind well before a storm ever arrives, letting the
Prospector plan a route or a dig around what's coming.

`+5min/lv` how far ahead upcoming weather changes can be sensed. Level 1 shows you the
current wind direction and speed.

Specialized in digging mine shafts and gathering mineral resources.

Level 1 enables you to place a mining shaft
`-10%/lv` mining time
`+20 resource lv/lv` that can be mined, up to resource level 100+ at max rank

Turns the rough gemstones a Miner digs up into cut stones fit for an Artificer's socket
or a Trader's scale. Can cut raw gems recovered from mining into faceted gemstones,
increasing their value and unlocking their use in socketed equipment.

Higher levels unlock cutting higher-grade gems
`-8%/lv` chance to shatter a gem while cutting

Lets a Miner push shafts deeper than good sense would recommend, into ground that pays
off precisely because nobody else risks it. Grants access to deeper, more dangerous mine
shafts holding rarer ore veins and the odd buried structure.

`+10% more resources/lv`

The Miner's capstone: a feel for what's underfoot precise enough to map a shaft before
the first swing of the pick.

Can sense ore and gem deposits through solid rock within 5m / Lv.

Adapt and improvise weapons and armor to better suit your needs and protect you. Each
attempt can fail, and a failed attempt can destroy the equipment outright.

Weaponry Research raises the odds; Master Smith raises them further.

Reads what has walked over a patch of ground, from the prints it left. Ground that takes
no print - rock, paving, ice - keeps no tracks at all, at any rank.

`+3 tiles/lv` how far around the read point you can search
Level 2 reads which way the trail led
Level 3 names what made it, and how strong it was
Level 4 names another master by name
The guild may carry an emblem. It shows on its members, its Stronghold and its banners.

The guild is recognised by the realm. It may found a Guild Stronghold and attack the
installations of other guilds - and its own Stronghold may be attacked in turn.

Hires a steward for the Guild Stronghold. Members can open the guild storage at the
steward and return to the Stronghold when they fall.

A storage every member with the right rank can use, kept by the steward.

Each level adds more storage space.
Allows the guild to call watchers, Bestia that guard the Guild Stronghold.
The watchers of the Guild Stronghold hit harder and attack faster.
Investing in the Guild Stronghold has a 50% chance to give one free extra point.

More members can join the guild.

`+4 members/lv`

Members near the guild master fight with more strength.

`+1 STR/lv` within 15 m of the guild master

Members near the guild master aim more precisely.

`+1 DEX/lv` within 15 m of the guild master

Members near the guild master endure more.

`+1 VIT/lv` within 15 m of the guild master

Members near the guild master move and react faster.

`+1 AGI/lv` within 15 m of the guild master

Members near the guild master channel more magic.

`+1 INT/lv` within 15 m of the guild master

Members near the guild master resist magic better.

`+1 WIL/lv` within 15 m of the guild master

Everything a member of the guild defeats is more likely to drop its items.

`+5%/lv` of each drop's own chance - at Lv.5 a 10% drop becomes 12.5%

The members around the caster move faster for a short time.

`+25%` movement speed for 10s, within 15 m. Cooldown 60s for the whole guild.

The members around the caster gain strength, dexterity and intelligence.

`+5 STR, DEX and INT` for 180s, within 30 m. Cooldown 180s for the whole guild.

The members around the caster recover HP, Mana and stamina faster.

`+50%/lv` regeneration for 60s, within 30 m. Cooldown 300s for the whole guild.

Restores 90% of the HP and Mana of the members around the caster, within 30 m.

Cooldown 180s for the whole guild.

Calls every member of the guild to the caster. Works only inside the guild's own
Stronghold.

Cooldown 300s for the whole guild.

Members may plant a War Banner. Casting the skill calls every member of the guild to the
banner - even into an enemy Stronghold. Enemies can cut the banner down.

Cooldown 900s for the whole guild, separate from Emergency Recall.
Heals a friend a little. The first spell every healer learns.
Heals a friend for a fair amount. Used to treat wounds.
Heals a friend for a great amount.
Quick attack which uses the body weight in a short range melee attack. It does only little damage but is quick and cheap.
Rushes up to three tiles at the target and drives the skull into it.
Leaps up to five tiles onto the target. Everything within a tile of the landing may be stunned for a moment.
Throws its whole body against the target. The heavier the bestia and its load, the harder it lands.
Five quick, light blows on the target, one after the other.
Charges up to ten tiles at the target. The longer the run-up, the harder it hits.
A heavy blow aimed to crush rather than cut. Shields and bones bend under it.
Brings its full weight down in one blow, like a smith's hammer on the anvil.
Grabs the target and tears at it with everything it has.
Charges in a straight line and tramples the target into the ground.
A blow to the head that very likely leaves the target stunned.
One blow with the strength of a landslide. It throws the target three tiles back.
Flings a small stone. Weak, but quick, and it often breaks off what the target was casting.
A long, aimed shot with a single quill. It reaches far and finds weak spots.
Two or three spines at the same target, each weaker than a single shot.
A long, hardened spike that goes straight through armour.
A storm of barbed darts. Now and then one sticks and leaves a bleeding wound.
A wave of thorns as long as daggers, shot with deadly aim.
A deep cut that very likely keeps bleeding while the target moves or fights.
Slams the ground and throws everyone close by three tiles away.
Raw mana rains down on an area. It hurts everyone inside and fills their mana a little.
Spits a small dart of flame at a single target. Quick to cast and hard to dodge.
Bites with jaws that glow like coals. The wound keeps smoking afterwards.
Sets the ground ablaze. Whatever stands in the flames burns, and may catch fire itself.
A ball of fire that bursts on impact. It may set the ground alight.
Wraps itself in flame and crashes into the target.
A thin ray of white-hot fire that burns straight through any magic guard.
While the caster holds the spell, pillars of fire strike the area one after another.
Flings a sharp shard of ice at a single target.
Spits a hard jet of water. It may slow the target for a moment.
A bite so cold it numbs the flesh around it.
Breathes a cone of freezing air over everyone in front of it.
A cold fog settles on the ground. Whatever stands in it may freeze solid.
Strikes with the weight of a breaking wave.
Hurls a hailstone the size of a fist. It hits hard and leaves the target shivering.
A rushing stream of water that slams into the target.
While the caster holds the spell, a howling blizzard batters the area.
Shoots a sharp splinter of stone out of the ground at a single target.
Tears a rock out of the ground and throws it.
A blow with a fist or hoof hardened like stone.
Whirling sand grinds at the target and may trap it in place.
Stamps until the ground shakes. Everyone close by is hurt and slowed to half speed.
Lifts a boulder, or becomes one, and brings it down on the target.
A lance of stone impales the target and may pin it in place for three seconds.
The ground opens up under an area and swallows what stands on it.
A small arc of lightning that jumps to a single target.
A blade of wind that cuts at range.
Beats its wings against the target with the force of a gust.
Charges the air in an area. Anyone inside is shocked again and again.
A spinning wind that sweeps over an area and throws everyone about.
Dives from above, carried by a howling wind.
A bolt of lightning that jumps on to up to two more foes close to each other.
A hurricane breaks loose and moves away from its caster, tearing at everything in its path.
Spits venom into the target's eyes. It may blind it.
A quick sting that leaves a little poison behind.
A bolt of green venom that may poison the target.
A cloud of foul gas hangs over the ground and may poison whoever breathes it.
Tears into the target with claws dripping with venom. It is very likely poisoned.
Exhales a sickly haze around itself. Everyone in it is very likely poisoned.
A stream of acid that eats through armor and flesh.
Spreads a plague across an area. Everyone in it is very likely poisoned.
Focuses light into a single, searing beam.
A strike blessed with holy light. The unnatural fear it.
Consecrates the ground. Only the undead and demons on it are hurt, and they often catch fire.
A heavy blow that falls like a verdict.
A ring of holy light bursts out from the caster.
A ray of pure light that burns away the unnatural. The undead fear it most.
A pillar of light erupts and sears everything in it, the undead and demons worst of all.
A bolt of living darkness that chills the soul.
Rakes the target with claws made of shadow.
Darkness pools on the ground and gnaws at anyone inside.
A wave of darkness rolls out and swallows the light.
For a moment the light goes out, and then the blow lands.
A spear of darkness pulled from somewhere far below.
Night falls on an area. Everything in it is hurt and blinded while it lasts.
Hurls a fragment of spirit at the target. It passes through armor as if it were not there.
A cold touch from a hand that is not quite there.
Restless spirits cling to an area and claw at the living.
A burst of spirit energy that tears at everyone close by.
Rushes through the target. Its body passes, the pain stays.
Tears at the target's spirit and rips away some of its mana.
Reaches for every soul in an area. The caster heals for part of what it takes.
Flings a sharp splinter of bone.
Grabs with a cold, rotting hand. Now and then the wound festers into poison.
A bolt of grave energy that withers what it touches.
Rot spreads across the ground. Whatever stands in it may sicken, and heals do it only half the good.
A blow with a club of fused bones.
Pulls the life out of the target, one heartbeat at a time.
The dead rise for a moment and drag the living down with them.
Licks its own wounds. Not much, but it keeps a young bestia going.
Knits its own flesh together over the next seconds.
Heals a friend and washes out poison, wounds, fire, sickness and blindness.
A long howl that makes its blood run hot. It hits harder for a while.
Hits harder and shrugs off blows for a while. Afterwards it is worn out for a few seconds.
Blesses a friend's weapon. Its plain blows hit as Holy for a while.
A wind at its back makes every step and every swing quicker.
A roar that makes every friend within ten tiles hit harder.
For a while every blow heals it by half the damage it deals.
Drops all defence for raw strength and quicker swings.
A low growl that makes every foe close by hit softer.
A piercing screech that throws off the aim of every foe close by.
Bites at the target's legs. Its swings come much slower for a while.
Turns a 5×5 patch into a mire. Whoever stands in it is clumsy, slow and loses any haste.
The target starts turning to stone. If nothing cures it within ten seconds, it is stone for thirty.
A roar so fierce that foes close by may run away in fear.
Ages the target's body by years: less health, less vitality, slower healing.
Snuffles through the undergrowth and turns up grain, berries or herbs at its feet. Works once every five minutes.
Shakes out a fleece of wool, and sometimes a tuft of soft fur. Works once every ten minutes.
Digs where it smells something buried: clay, a lost coin, now and then a rough gem.
Picks the herbs it knows are good to eat, and a few you would not have known about.
Spins a spool of fine silk thread for tailors.
Raids a wild hive and brings back a dripping honeycomb, stings and all.
Breaks a lump of ore out of the nearest rock. It never asks which rock is yours.
Tears a young tree out by its roots for firewood or timber.
Wobbles until a blob of jelly drips off. It does not seem to mind.
Scrapes the salt that dries on its hide after a swim in the sea.
Huddles up against a friend. For five minutes and more, the cold has to be 15 °C colder before it hurts them.
Wraps a friend in cool mist. For five minutes and more, the heat has to be 15 °C hotter before it hurts them.
Puts the wind at a friend's back, so they run faster for a while.
Blessing 5 on a friend: more strength, dexterity and intelligence for a while.
Puts its nose to the ground and reads the tracks there: who passed, how many and how long ago.
Circles above and reads the tracks below from the air.
Splashes around with all its might. Nothing happens. Nothing ever happens.
Laughs out loud. Everyone nearby hears it, and nobody likes it.
Makes rude faces and noises at whoever is looking.
Wails in grief. It frightens nobody it is fond of.
Announces the doom of everyone nearby, at length. The doom never quite arrives.
A shard of ice that does little harm but often freezes the target solid.
A burst of frost around the caster that may freeze everyone close by.
Only for the undead: it may destroy one outright, else it burns with holy light. Bosses are never destroyed.
While the caster holds the spell, holy light strikes the area again and again. It hurts only the undead, ghosts and demons. Uses up a mana crystal.
Bends a wild undead to fight its own kind for a while. Bosses and the much stronger resist.
Takes a quarter of the target's health, whatever its guard. A boss loses a twentieth.
Only while berserk and with half its mana: pours all of it into one devastating blow. Afterwards the mana does not come back for five minutes.
Heals a friend for a huge amount.
Heals every friend in a small circle.
Hallows a large patch of ground that heals every friend in it for ten seconds. Uses up a mana crystal.
A friend turns single-target skills back on their caster, a few times.
Wraps a friend in plates of bone that soak up the next few blows. Uses up a bone shard.
Its hide turns acid. Weapons that hit it wear down.
A friend's weapon burns: its plain blows hit as Fire.
A friend's weapon freezes over: its plain blows hit as Water.
A friend's weapon grows heavy as stone: its plain blows hit as Earth.
A friend's weapon crackles: its plain blows hit as Wind.
A friend is wrapped in fire: hits on it are weighed as against Fire.
A friend is wrapped in frost: hits on it are weighed as against Water.
A friend is wrapped in stone: hits on it are weighed as against Earth.
A friend is wrapped in wind: hits on it are weighed as against Wind.
A 3×3 wall of wind for ten seconds. Shots and arrows at anyone inside miss.
Muddles the target's head. It may walk the wrong way for a while.
Strips the target of its buffs.
Knocks the weapon out of the target's hand, and it stays empty for a while. A wild bestia hits softer instead.
Tears the target's armour off. Nothing can be worn in its place for a while.
A blow with acid on its claws. The target's weapon and armour lose a good part of their durability.
Blessing 10 on a friend: much more strength, dexterity and intelligence for a while.
Senses masters and their bestia within fifteen tiles, hidden ones too, and marks them on the map for thirty seconds.
Digs in out of sight. It cannot move, but area attacks pass over it. Staying hidden costs mana, and any action gives it away.
Moves unseen and slower. Any blow, an area one too, gives it away. Staying hidden costs mana.
